steps: Some Toys-Plastic, Some Plastic-Metal, No Metal-Chemical
Model: Chemical overlapping Plastic (non-Metal part) or Toy possible, and also disjoint
I fails in model where Chemical disjoint from Plastic; II fails in model where a Toy is Chemical
check_code:
import itertools
regions=range(16)  # membership bitmask over T,P,M,C
T,P,M,C=1,2,4,8
def has(S,f): return any(f(r) for r in S)
def models():
    for bits in range(1,1<<16):
        S=[r for r in range(16) if bits>>r&1]
        if has(S,lambda r:r&T and r&P) and has(S,lambda r:r&P and r&M) and not has(S,lambda r:r&M and r&C):
            yield S
c1=lambda S:has(S,lambda r:r&C and r&P)
c2=lambda S:not has(S,lambda r:r&T and r&C)
ms=list(models())
f1=all(c1(S) for S in ms); f2=all(c2(S) for S in ms)
assert (f1,f2)==(False,False)

s='f h _ h _ g f _ h g _ h _ f f _ g _ h _ f'.split()
opts={'A':'g h f f g h f g','B':'g h f h g f f g','C':'g h f h g h f g','D':'g h f h g h h g'}

    it=iter(opts[o].split()); return ''.join(next(it) if x=='_' else x for x in s)
